title: A requirements revision on a leased item is queued and reaches the worker at its next sync, instead of being refused
description: A fixture item leased to a worker keeps its lease through a requirements revision: the revision is recorded at once, the worker's sync shows the changed criteria and acknowledges them, a complete before that sync is refused naming the revision, and one after it is accepted and judged against the revised criteria.

steps.name: revise requirements under a live lease, refuse complete before the sync, accept it after
